verdict.rationale: The whole product is about handing logo work to an AI agent. Once installed, the agent picks up the skill automatically and runs the job end to end: brief, greyscale concepts with a recommendation, a self-audit of its own rendered drafts, a user checkpoint, then the full kit. However, the AI is the host agent (Claude or another Agent Skills-compatible agent), not an assistant the product ships itself, so the user must bring and configure that external agent. Missing for 10: a self-contained built-in assistant that needs no third-party agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of the delegation workflow.
